chunks: Sufficient is Allah as a Reckoner.
Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, said: 'Indeed, Allah will make the people account for what they do.'
And He said: 'And your Lord is not unjust to the servants.'

key_terms.ظَلَّامٍ: Unjust / One who treats with injustice
key_terms.وَكَيْلًا: A Reckoner / One who measures precisely

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Allah's justice in reckoning human deeds?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq utilizes this narration to reinforce the doctrine of divine justice (*Adl*), a cornerstone of Shia theology, by emphasizing that Allah’s reckoning is precise and devoid of any injustice. This aligns with the Imams' teachings that God’s attributes are perfect and that every deed, whether small or great, is recorded with exactitude. The reference to specific verses underscores the certainty of the Hereafter as a direct consequence of human agency under divine surveillance.
